script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: It says Peter and John were not selling anything or starting a fight. The passage does not establish either detail.
The passage does not say that nobody was passing a basket.
It says the message kept growing while Peter and John were in custody. The passage says many who heard believed, but does not give that sequence.
It places Peter's answer in the morning. The passage says the leaders assembled the next day, but gives no time of day.
It says the rulers and elders were sitting. The passage does not give their posture.
It says the rulers and elders were standing. The passage does not give their posture.
The claim that this started at the temple draws on an earlier passage without a reference to it.
It says Peter and John's boldness traced back to Jesus. The text notes their boldness and that they had been with Jesus, but does not explicitly state that cause.
The joke about it being hard to argue with someone who is standing up does not make logical sense.
It says Peter and John were standing in one spot as they spoke. The passage does not say that.
It says the people were not blaming anyone. Their glorifying God does not establish that nobody was blaming anyone.
It states what the crowd was not feeling. The passage says they glorified God, but does not say none of them felt doubt.
It says the believers took the report to God first. The passage does not establish that order.
It calls the Lord and His Anointed One 'people,' which wrongly describes the Lord as a human being.
It says the believers asked for more boldness. They asked for complete boldness; the text does not say they asked for an increase.
It calls boldness the whole request, although the prayer also asks God to consider the threats and to heal and perform signs and wonders.
It calls the shaking an answer to prayer. The text says it happened after they prayed, but does not explicitly identify it as an answer.
It says the believers were not afraid to speak. The text says they spoke boldly, but does not state their feelings.
